jobs.title: Senior Backend .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an engineer who loves both setting a framework and contributing hands-on? Someone who not only writes code, but also determines the way ahead? As Senior Backend Engineer at Funda, you design, build and scale systems that help millions of potential house buyers and real estate agents every day. You work at the interface of technology, architecture and product development – and you have a voice that is listened to.

Your job in a nutshell

You are a technical heavyweight within Funda’s backend domain. You design scalable systems, improve the technical foundations of our platform and work on features that directly impact millions of users.

You have a fixed product team, but you also work across teams: you bring people, teams and ideas together to move us forward technically. With modern technology such as .NET 8, Kubernetes, Azure, event-driven architecture and Terraform, you ensure that our systems remain smart, scalable and future-ready.

What makes this role unique is the combination of technical depth, ownership and influence on how we build at Funda.

What you will do

Give direction to your team according to our lighthouse architecture and contribute to its further development.
Design and optimise critical systems that require high levels of performance and reliability.
Solve complex problems around scalability, data streams or systems integration.
Together with product managers and designers, ensure that the technical decisions align with the product vision.
Share knowledge and coach medior and junior engineers, and contribute to Funda's learning culture.
Work together with other senior and staff engineers to further develop Funda’s technical strategy.

Also read our Engineering blog:
How we use modular pipelines to empower our development team

Your team

At Funda, various scrum teams work on different parts of our platform: from improving the search experience to renewing the system with which estate real agents manage their properties.

We are currently recruiting for various teams. During the recruitment process, we will look together with you at where your knowledge, interests and ambitions would be best placed.

Whichever team you end up in, you will always work with a product manager, UX designer and various frontend and backend engineers on products that matter. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will also work a lot with our staff engineers such as Aleix: ‘My role as a Staff Engineer is to build a platform that lets you develop boldly, ship confidently, and sleep peacefully. Your job is to break it in all the best ways – to challenge assumptions, spot the cracks, and help us build something truly great together.’

Also read our Engineering blog:
How Golden Paths give our developers more time to actually develop

Why you want to become a Senior Backend .NET Engineer at Funda

You play a significant role in the realisation and further development of the technical route forward for a platform with millions of users.
You work on systems that process millions of visits every day, and that are highly demanding in terms of speed, reliability and scalability.
You have a direct impact on how potential house buyers, real estate agents and partners experience Funda.

This is you

You have broad experience with .NET Core, Azure, Kubernetes and event-driven architecture.
You have a strong vision of scalable, maintenance-friendly software and know how to transform this vision into action.
You work across teams and systems, and communicate clearly about technical choices.
You lead and coach colleagues by sharing knowledge and introducing best practices.
You feel responsible for the quality and performance of our backend systems.
You're currently living in the Netherlands and speak fluent English (Dutch is a plus).
And you have enough experience to justifiably call yourself senior level.

Love being spoiled? Well, we love spoiling you!

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
About Clockworks

Clockworks is a Rotterdam-based AI company. For more than ten years we have turned cameras, sensors and messy data streams into systems that read, look, count and predict, and then quietly do their job inside the operations of utilities, logistics and industrial companies.

A demo that works eighty percent of the time takes a week. We are in the business of the last twenty percent: the photo that is not quite sharp but still needs to be readable, off-hours peaks in traffic, a customer’s fifteen-year-old system everything has to plug into. We work in small teams with everything in-house to solve a problem end to end, with software and AI engineering in one room, which is why what we build actually goes live. Alongside client work we build our own products, such as Blicker, our meter-reading API for utility companies, and everything runs on ClockworksOS, our own toolkit for data, models and production systems.

The gears of a clock are complicated, and that is exactly why reading the time is simple. The same concept holds for the solutions we build and how we work.

The role

If the AI is the brain of a solution, our software engineers build the body around it. As Solution Architect you decide what that body looks like before a line of it is written, and then you help write it. You define how a vague AI idea becomes a system that meets real requirements for performance, scalability, security and maintainability, how it fits into whatever the client already has running, and you build the parts that matter most yourself.

You are one of two architects and you sit across everything we build: client projects, products such as Blicker, and ClockworksOS underneath them. You see architectural risk before anyone else does and say so, whether to a junior engineer, a client CTO or Clockworks leadership; when a project's technical direction is contested, you cut through the noise with a clear, defensible recommendation.

This is a coding architect role, not a slide-deck one. You combine everything a senior software engineer does, writing production code, reviewing pull requests, setting up infrastructure, with designing systems before implementation starts and reviewing all Clockworks solutions from an SE, DevOps and security perspective. At a team of our size there is no room for an architect who only draws boxes: the credibility of your designs comes from the fact that you can, and do, implement them.

What you'll work on

Build production code on the critical parts of our systems, from ClockworksOS platform components to the integration layer of a client project, so your architectural judgment stays grounded in what it takes to implement it.
Design scalable, secure and maintainable architectures for AI-integrated systems, from cloud to edge, and turn AI solution concepts into concrete implementation plans.
Review all Clockworks solutions, products and client projects alike, from an SE, DevOps and security lens, and raise architectural risk before a project hits trouble.
Define and govern our technical standards and architectural guidelines, documented in architectural decision records, and lead technical due diligence on complex engagements.
Build alignment around architectural decisions: bring engineers, clients and stakeholders along through clear, objective argumentation, keeping the end user and operational reality in view.
Mentor senior and medior engineers, and stay current on the full SE landscape, from cloud and security to the role of AI coding agents in how we build.

Who we're looking for

This is a senior role by definition: not the next step after senior engineer, but a distinct profile. You have:

8+ years of software engineering experience, including several years designing and owning the architecture of systems that run in production.
Deep, breadth-first knowledge of architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven, serverless), cloud-native architecture (Azure preferred), Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or Pulumi, and the judgment to know which of these a specific problem actually needs.
A solid grasp of security architecture (zero-trust, data protection, GDPR, ideally ISO 27001) and of API design, integration patterns and data platform architecture, especially with systems that were never designed with AI in mind.
Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (most of our work is in Python) and the wish to keep using them: a substantial part of your week is building, and you want it that way.
The ability to explain complex trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, to hold your ground constructively when your view contradicts what a team has already committed to, and to know when to hold a standard and when to accept a compromise, with its cost made explicit.

It would be great if you also have experience architecting systems around machine learning or computer vision models (cloud and edge), with event streaming or high-volume data pipelines, with AI coding agents and an opinion on how they change the way teams build, or with working across several clients and codebases at a consultancy or agency. Fluent professional English is required; Dutch helps in client conversations.

Not ticking every box? If the hands-on part and the judgment are there, we would still like to hear from you.

Why us?

We offer:

A seat across everything Clockworks builds: client systems in utilities, logistics and industry, our own products, and the platform underneath them.
Architecture that has to hold up in the real world: computer vision on the edge, high-volume streams from cameras and sensors, and AI models running inside the operations of utilities and logistics companies. Nothing we build is a demo; everything goes live.
A small, senior team of engineers with backgrounds in AI, computer science and applied sciences, where software and AI engineering sit in one room and what we design actually goes live.
Responsibility that comes early and sits high: at a boutique like ours you are in the client conversations, the design decisions and the trade-offs from day one.
The latest language models and coding agents as part of how we work, from first analysis to code, and the freedom to shape how the team uses them.
A flat, informal company culture in the heart of Rotterdam, with competitive remuneration, flexible working conditions and a team that backs your professional ambitions.

Interested? Send us your CV and a short note on a system you designed that is still running, and why. Apply via our careers page or at careers@clockworks.co.

We hire directly. Agency submissions are not accepted.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Stel je voor: over een jaar kijkt een bestuurder naar een dashboard met actuele cijfers over onderwijs en onderzoek, en vertrouwt daar blindelings op. Niet omdat het toevallig klopt, maar omdat jij het datamodel eronder hebt gebouwd. Tien verschillende collega’s van decentrale teams werken dagelijks met data die via jouw platform beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en actueel is, zonder dat zij ooit stilstaan bij hoeveel werk daarachter zit.

Deze functie is nieuw: Hogeschool Rotterdam wil meer focus op data. Je bouwt een nieuw, onderliggend dataplatform waarmee de management rapportages en de decentrale ontwikkeling van ongeveer tien fte structureel en toekomstbestendig worden ondersteund.

Deze rol maakt onderdeel uit van de bredere digitaliseringsagenda van de hogeschool, waarin ook een vernieuwd IAM- en integratieplatform wordt gebouwd. Je speelt daarin een sleutelrol.
Dat maakt dit een kans om vanaf de fundamenten mee te bouwen aan een dataplatform, in plaats van in te stappen op iets dat al vaststaat.

Het team Data, Integratie en IAM groeit van drie naar maximaal acht teamleden. Je pakt zelf de inhoudelijke regie op dit vlak, met drie architecten als klankbord. Voor wie architectuurkeuzes het liefst zelf vormgeeft, is dit precies de ruimte die je zoekt.

Je bouwt mee aan een platform dat grotendeels nog moet worden neergezet, binnen kaders van portfolio en architectuur, maar met veel eigen ruimte voor keuzes.

In de eerste periode bepaal je samen met je team de vraag en behoefte en leg je deze vast in een roadmap. Vervolgens ga je aan de oplossing bouwen. Jij bent de data-expert, maar je werkt hierin nauw samen met je team.

Je vertaalt informatiebehoeften naar datamodellen en datastructuren, passend binnen organisatiebrede standaarden
Je ontwerpt en realiseert data pipelines en datasets voor rapportages, dashboards en analytics, en werkt toe naar vervanging van de huidige legacy-oplossing
Je past sectorstandaarden zoals OOAPI en organisatie-specifieke datamodellen toe en breidt ze uit
Je stemt af met de IAM- en Integratie-collega's binnen je team over autorisatie, datatoegankelijkheid en datakwaliteit
Je werkt samen met BI- en analytics-teams aan duurzame, goed gedocumenteerde data-oplossingen

Wat we jou bieden

Als Data Engineer bij Hogeschool Rotterdam werk je in Rotterdam aan een nieuw dataplatform voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Je krijgt een jaarcontract volgens de CAO HBO, met een dienstverband van 0,8 tot 1,0 fte en uitzicht op een vast dienstverband bij goed functioneren. Parttime is bespreekbaar.
€ 3.609 tot € 5.377 bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband, schaal 10 CAO HBO
8% vakantiegeld en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering
9 weken vakantie per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband
Hybride werken, doorgaans twee tot drie dagen per week op locatie
Pensioen via ABP, fietsregeling, vergoedingen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

45 duurzame inzetbaarheidsuren voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en werk-privebalans. Vakantiedagen kun je het hele jaar door flexibel inzetten en je bent niet gebonden aan de schoolvakanties. Je ontvangt vergoedingen voor internet, reizen en thuiswerken en hebt de mogelijkheid tot betaald ouderschapsverlof. Er is geen vast budget per medewerker, maar een teambrede pool voor scholing en ontwikkeling die wordt verdeeld op basis van functioneren en behoefte. Bij goede prestaties is er ruim budget beschikbaar om je verder te ontwikkelen. Bij een salariswens net boven de schaal kan een markttoelage worden toegepast, te bevestigen door Hogeschool Rotterdam.

Wat we van jou verwachten

Als Data Engineer bij Hogeschool Rotterdam in Rotterdam geef je zelfstandig richting aan de ontwikkeling van het dataplatform. Senioriteit is op dit moment doorslaggevend: we zoeken iemand die zelfstandig richting kan geven, niet alleen kan uitvoeren. Je brengt technische bagage mee en maakt complexe datavraagstukken helder voor business stakeholders.
Je hebt ervaring met datamodellering, bijvoorbeeld met OOAPI en andere relevante standaarden, en met het ontwerpen van logische en fysieke datamodellen
Je hebt kennis van SQL en ervaring met datawarehousing, data lakes of moderne analyticsplatformen zoals Microsoft Fabric en OneLake
Je hebt ervaring met BI-oplossingen en rapportagetools zoals Power BI, en basiskennis van datavisualisatieprincipes
Je hebt programmeerervaring, bij voorkeur in C#/.NET, en ervaring met web-API's en formaten als JSON, YAML en XML
Je begrijpt data- en informatieanalyse, datakwaliteit, metadata en governance en hebt ervaring met werken in een agile/Scrum-omgeving

Data engineering is de kern van deze rol; C#/.NET-ervaring is gewenst, maar een sterk profiel op databronnen en datamodellering weegt het zwaarst. Je durft uit te spreken wat er anders, mooier of effectiever kan, en helpt het team daarmee groeien. Dat vinden we net zo belangrijk als je technische bagage.

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

At TOPIC, we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the driven and ambitious Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
who enjoys writing production-quality code to automate testing of complex embedded systems that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers
Develop automated tests across multiple levels (unit, integration, system) as part of the development process
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure to enable fast and reliable feedback
Analyze complex systems and failures, and trace issues to root cause in code
Drive testability, observability, and quality-by-design principles within development teams
Work on high-tech systems (embedded / hardware-software integration / distributed systems) with real-world impact
Take ownership of technical decisions around test architecture and tooling
Continuously improve automation strategy with a strong focus on engineering scalability and maintainability

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

Challenging and interesting projects in different domains
Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues
Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions
Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy
Tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57,000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands)

This will keep you healthy:

A good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working
An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym
The home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment
Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks

What do you bring as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar
5 years of work experience in the high‑tech domain
Experience with programming in Python, C++ and/or C# and familiar with applying OO principles.
Hands‑on experience with test automation
Preferably experience with the ROBOT Framework and methodologies such as TDD, BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
A Funda QA Engineer doesn't simply slam buttons hoping that something will break. They don't go for idiot-proof, but instead work on improving the most important and intangible element of all, which is quality: meaning the quality of every line of code, every sprint and every release by the team. That makes a Funda QA Engineer the A in Team Awesome .

Your job in a nutshell

As a QA Engineer, you have a choice: you can either slow processes down or speed them up. Your preference speaks for itself. You enable the team to excel. One release per day or per week won't suffice; you go for continuous deployment whereby 10 releases a day become the norm.

Your responsibilities

Testing: conducting thorough testing to identify defects, bugs and issues
Test automation: using your knowledge of the code and domain, create automated tests to streamline testing process and make bug fixes and code changes
Quality assurance: ensuring that software products meet quality standards and specifications
Collaboration: working closely with developers, product managers and stakeholders and promoting a whole team approach to testing by sharing your knowledge

Read more in our Engineering blog post about why we ditched Selenium for Playwright (and how we nailed it)

The team

You will be an integral part of a multidisciplinary Scrum team, consisting of a Product Owner, UX Designer, and multiple Frontend and Backend Developers, and you will be part of the QA practise within Funda.

Why being a QA Engineer at Funda is awesome

We understand better than anyone that QA Engineers are a hot commodity. So why would you want to work at Funda? Apart from the fact that we are a top brand with large volume and traffic, and a riverfront office in Amsterdam (located on the IJ), your future colleague Jome (who broke her personal employment record here at Funda) captures it aptly: "You'd be working with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. It's both challenging and exciting.”

This is you

You have a wealth of experience in the field of Agile Testing within a Scrum environment. You have experience with test automation and programming (C#, Nuxt, Flutter), perhaps a result of your background as a developer. Additionally, you have experience with a Unit Testing framework (hopefully xunit), with designing, creating and maintaining automated tests (Playwright and integration tests in .NET Core) and with the use of version control systems (like Git and Github). You also have working knowledge of Azure DevOps and Kubernetes.

Next to that:
A bachelor's or other university degree in science
At least 5 years of relevant work experience
Knowledge of a Continuous Delivery software strategy
Experience working with an issue tracking system (e.g. Jira – check out our tech stack here)
A good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
You're currently living in the Netherlands

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

LORENZ Life Sciences Group is a leading provider of innovative software solutions dedicated to facilitating the secure and efficient digital exchange of data within the pharmaceutical industry. Our core mission is to accelerate the availability of vital medications and therapies to patients worldwide by streamlining the complex processes involved in drug approval and regulatory compliance. As an agile and forward-thinking organization, we pride ourselves on maintaining a flexible organizational structure that enables quick decision-making and fosters innovation. With a strong commitment to improving healthcare outcomes, we continuously seek talented professionals who share our passion for technological advancement and societal impact. Our international team and dynamic work environment provide an excellent platform for personal growth and professional development, making us a preferred employer in the health tech sector.

About The Role

We are actively seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer (m/w/d) to join our engineering team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex software solutions within the .NET ecosystem, primarily focusing on C# and .NET Core (including the latest .NET 10). You will play a key role in implementing high-performance REST APIs within microservice architectures, ensuring our solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with industry best practices. Your expertise will contribute to enhancing our existing systems and pioneering new features that support the digital transformation of regulatory processes. Collaboration is at the heart of our development culture, and you will work closely with other senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and contribute to technical mentoring and knowledge sharing. Your innovative mindset and passion for software craftsmanship will help us maintain our competitive edge and deliver value to our clients and end-users.

Qualifications

Multiple years of professional experience in software development with C#, .NET Core, and the entire .NET ecosystem.
Strong proficiency with relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.
Hands-on experience with software architecture design, distributed systems, modern CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies.
Familiarity with agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban, with a collaborative and knowledge-sharing approach.
Passion for software development, complemented by a structured working style and quick comprehension skills.
Fluent in both German and English, with excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement modern software solutions using C# and .NET Core (including .NET 10), focusing on building robust REST APIs within microservice architectures.
Ensure high code quality through adherence to Clean Code principles, SOLID design patterns, and comprehensive testing strategies.
Conduct code reviews, provide technical mentorship to team members, and actively introduce innovative ideas, tools, and best practices to improve development processes.
Work extensively with relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, and quickly adapt to new technologies as needed.
Engage in spontaneous brainstorming sessions with senior engineers to address real-world challenges, demonstrating problem-solving skills and proactive collaboration.

Benefits

Joining LORENZ Life Sciences Group offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal and professional growth. Enjoy flexible working hours and hybrid work options that allow you to balance work and life effectively. We provide an attractive starting holiday entitlement of 30 days, with additional days based on tenure, ensuring ample time for rest and rejuvenation. Our organization offers a secure employment environment within an owner-managed company with an international team, complemented by a competitive salary package ranging from 55,000 to 80,000 euros per year, and performance-based bonuses. We prioritize continuous learning and development, partnering with you to identify relevant training opportunities that foster your career advancement. Our modern Frankfurt office is equipped with the latest technology, a stylish workspace, and amenities such as a company parking lot with E-lades stations and the option to lease a company bike. We promote a vibrant company culture through regular events, a relaxed Duz culture, and activities like in-house yoga and communal meals, fostering a sense of community and teamwork.

Equal Opportunity

LORENZ Life Sciences Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives and experiences enrich our organization and contribute to our success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is fair and unbiased, and we strive to provide equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to make meaningful contributions.

About The Company

AgileGrid Solutions is a pioneering technology firm committed to delivering innovative software solutions that facilitate digital transformation across diverse industries. Our expertise lies in integrating advanced AI technologies and developing scalable backend architectures to meet the evolving needs of our clients. We prioritize quality, reliability, and future-proofing in all our offerings, ensuring our solutions support sustainable growth and operational excellence. Our company culture fosters collaboration, continuous learning, and a passion for technological innovation, creating an environment where talented professionals can thrive, grow their skills, and make a significant impact in the tech landscape.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Backend Developer with a strong passion for shaping AI-driven solutions and influencing technological strategies. In this role, you will go beyond routine maintenance and actively participate in designing and developing scalable backend systems. Your extensive experience will enable you to make critical decisions related to software architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integrations. A key aspect of this position involves leveraging modern AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar agents to enhance productivity, code quality, and development efficiency. You will be responsible for creating innovative AI-supported applications, integrating external systems, and collaborating closely with product managers, domain experts, and fellow developers to transform technological possibilities into practical, deployable solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to embed AI coding tools into daily workflows, enabling faster, more secure, and high-quality software delivery while maintaining rigorous standards of security and maintainability.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have between 7 to 10 years of professional experience in backend development, demonstrating a solid understanding of software architecture, API design, database management, and automated testing. Proven expertise in at least one backend technology such as Python, Java, C#, TypeScript, or Node.js is essential. Candidates should possess a thorough knowledge of version control systems like Git and CI/CD workflows. Experience working with AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot, including prompt engineering, context management, and quality assurance of AI-generated code, is highly desirable. Strong ownership mentality, excellent collaboration skills, and the ability to transfer knowledge effectively are crucial. Proficiency in German is required, along with good English skills, to facilitate seamless communication within our diverse team environment.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing complex backend solutions from initial concept through to deployment in production environments. You will take ownership of software architecture, define API specifications, data models, and ensure seamless system integrations. A significant aspect of your role involves utilizing AI coding tools effectively for implementation, refactoring, testing, and troubleshooting tasks. You will critically evaluate AI-generated code for quality, security, and maintainability, ensuring compliance with industry standards. Collaboration with product teams, domain experts, and fellow developers is essential to develop AI-enabled applications and services, including integrating large language model (LLM) APIs and external systems. You will contribute to establishing and maintaining best practices, development standards, and technological innovations within the team. Your expertise will influence the future of AI-driven backend development and directly impact project success and organizational growth.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including a €600 health budget for massages, glasses, and other health-related expenses. Our top-tier health insurance coverage extends to you and your family, providing peace of mind. Additional perks include fitness bonuses, quick access to medical specialists, and a digital health coach to support your well-being. We promote flexible work arrangements with options for remote work and provide 30 days of vacation to ensure work-life balance. Job security is guaranteed through permanent employment contracts. Employees have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance their skills. Our modern green office spaces foster a productive work environment, complemented by team events, discounts, parking facilities, fresh fruit, beverages, and online shopping discounts. We also offer company car options for professional and private use, environmentally friendly mobility solutions such as JobRad leasing, and access to fitness and health services via EGYM Wellpass. Additional programs include JobCar, sustainable E-Car leasing, and affordable hardware leasing through MeinMPP.

Equal Opportunity

AgileGrid Solutions is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds are essential for innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is transparent and fair, and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. Join us in becoming part of a forward-thinking organization that values diversity, equity, and inclusion at every level of our work culture.

jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Contribute to meaningful modernisation outcomes across the platform and related services.
Deliver high-quality frontend and backend changes that are secure, maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.
Apply agreed engineering standards, coding practices and review feedback consistently.
Support faster, more predictable delivery by contributing to automation, CI/CD and DevOps improvements.
Collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and other engineers to solve delivery challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development

Develop modern Angular applications replacing legacy AngularJS user and administration portals.
Design, develop and maintain .NET backend services supporting distributed compute workloads.
Build and enhance REST APIs consumed by multiple business applications.
Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Platform Modernization

Participate in migration towards Azure Container Apps and containerised workloads.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to cloud-native platform modernization initiatives.
Participate in modernisation of deployment pipelines and release automation.
Help improve platform scalability, maintainability and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring software quality and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
Apply Clean Code principles, modern software design patterns and engineering best practices.
Support continuous integration and continuous delivery initiatives.
Contribute to zero-downtime deployment improvements.

Operations & Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.
Participate in production support and on-call rotation as part of the engineering team.
Contribute to troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous platform improvements.
Share knowledge and actively participate in building the engineering capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

4–6 years of commercial software development experience.
Strong experience with C#, modern .NET and ASP.NET.
Strong experience with Angular and TypeScript.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software engineering principles.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.
Understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles, with the ability and willingness to work with tools such as OpenTofu or Terraform.
Understanding of cloud-native application development principles.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Understanding of Clean Code principles and software design patterns.
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Ability to work within a collaborative cross-functional engineering team.

Soft Skills

Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive approach to problem solving.
Willingness to learn modern cloud platform technologies.
Passion for continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Azure Container Apps
Azure Batch
OpenTofu or Terraform
Playwright
SQL Server
Redis
SignalR
Experience working on cloud-native platforms
Experience modernising legacy enterprise applications

Additional Information

“For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 15 267 PLN Gross per month
(full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. jobs.description:
At ABB
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

__

Help shape the next generation of digital services at ABB Electrification Service Division. We are look-ing for a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to unlock agentic AI capabilities across our digital port-folio and turn them into real customer value. In this role, you will help build intelligent systems that support customers in achieving their most important asset management goals: higher reliability, bet-ter predictability, greater availability, improved sustainability, and smarter lifecycle decisions. You will work at the intersection of AI, backend engineering, and enterprise integration to transform architec-tural designs into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

ABB’s digital and service portfolio is increasingly focused on customer experience, comprehensive as-set management, digital enablement, and sustainability outcomes. This role is a key enabler for trans-lating that portfolio direction into intelligent products and workflows that help customers reduce downtime, improve maintenance decisions, optimize operations, and extend asset life.

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, you will build, integrate, and operate production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows across ABB ELSE digital services. You will own the engineering required to move beyond pilots into secure, reliable, enterprise-ready solutions. This includes agent orchestra-tion, enterprise tool integration, evaluation, monitoring, control mechanisms, and operational excel-lence. The role also has an important team uplift dimension: you will mentor colleagues and help raise the internal bar in agentic AI engineering.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.
Turn solution designs into scalable, production-ready implementations across the ELSE landscape.

Define effective patterns for tool use, context management, memory, orchestration, and workflow execution.
Create evaluation and validation approaches to ensure agent quality, safety, accuracy, and performance in real use cases.
Implement human approval flows, fallback mechanisms, and operational guardrails.
Ensure production readiness through testing, monitoring, deployment automation, and controlled releases.
Work closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and software teams to deliver reliable, business-ready ELSE solutions.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, including designing and delivering enterprise-grade backend and cloud-based solutions.
2-3+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agent-based workflows in production environments.
Strong backend engineering skills, ideally in C#/.NET, with Python as a strong plus.
Strong experience with APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and secure enterprise integration.
Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Data & AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Vilka är vi?

På Dyve hjälper vi ambitiösa organisationer att omsätta strategier och idéer inom verksamhet och teknik till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
Dyve finns i Stockholm och Örnsköldsvik. Nu rekryterar vi till vårt kontor i Örnsköldsvik, där vi bygger ett team som förenar verksamhetsförståelse med arkitektur, data, AI och tekniskt genomförande. Hos oss får du arbeta nära kunderna, ta stort ansvar och vara med och forma hur vi växer.
Vi arbetar nyfiket och prestigelöst, med stark tilltro till vad vi kan åstadkomma tillsammans.

Vem är du?

Du kombinerar arkitektens helhetsperspektiv med en stark förmåga att omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar.
Du kan förstå en verksamhets utmaningar, utforma en hållbar teknisk lösning och bidra aktivt till att ta den från idé till verklighet. Du trivs med att röra dig mellan kunddialoger, arkitekturfrågor och praktiskt genomförande.
Du kan förklara tekniska vägval för olika målgrupper och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att skapa resultat som håller över tid.

Vad tar du med dig?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att utforma lösningsarkitektur och utveckla moderna data- och AI-lösningar. Du behöver inte ha haft titeln Data & AI Solution Architect tidigare, men du drivs av att kombinera teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och praktiskt genomförande.
Vi ser gärna att du har flera av följande erfarenheter:
Utformning av lösningsarkitektur, dataarkitektur eller molnarkitektur
Utveckling av AI-lösningar och intelligenta applikationer
Integration av AI-lösningar med befintliga system, data och arbetsflöden
Att ta tekniska lösningar från idé och prototyp till användning i verksamheten
Att väga samman funktion, säkerhet, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltning
Att samarbeta nära kunder och team med olika kompetenser

Du har sannolikt erfarenhet av moderna plattformar och verktyg inom moln, data och AI, exempelvis Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, Kubernetes eller OpenShift.
Du är nyfiken, tar ansvar och arbetar prestigelöst. Du uttrycker dig väl på både svenska och engelska.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Du hjälper våra kunder att identifiera möjligheter inom data och AI och omsätta dem i lösningar som skapar verkligt värde.
Det innebär att du arbetar med både arkitektur och lösningsdesign samt bidrar till att lösningarna blir genomförbara, används i verksamheten och skapar affärsnytta.
I ett uppdrag kan du exempelvis kartlägga behov och förutsättningar, utforma hur data, AI-tjänster och system ska samverka, bygga en första lösning och vidareutveckla den för användning i verksamheten.
Du arbetar tillsammans med konsulter, projektledare och teknikspecialister, nära både kundens verksamhet och tekniska team.
Du är också med och bygger Dyves team i Örnsköldsvik. Här får du möjlighet att påverka våra erbjudanden, vår tekniska kompetens och hur vi utvecklas framåt.

Varför Dyve?

Från idé till verklighet: Utforma lösningen och var med och förverkliga den
Inflytande på riktigt: Påverka både kunduppdrag och hur Dyve utvecklas
Delägarskap på sikt: Möjlighet att bli delägare och vara med på vår tillväxtresa
Breda team: Arbeta med kollegor som bidrar med olika perspektiv och kompetenser
Prestigelös kultur: Korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och stark laganda
Bra villkor: Konkurrenskraftig lön, bonus, tjänstepension, sjukvårdsförsäkring, friskvårdsbidrag och personalaktieprogram
Gemenskap: Konferenser, inspirationsresor och sociala aktiviteter

Vill du kombinera arkitektur, data och AI med möjligheten att bygga både lösningar, erbjudanden och ett växande team i Örnsköldsvik? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer or Software Architect to industrial domain projects
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of industrial digitalization? If yes, we have an interesting opening for you! We are currently looking for a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect to join our Intelligent Devices team and play a key role at the intersection of technology and business.

Manufacturing industries are living in an era of accelerated change and rapid demand for renewal. Industrial digitalization, green transition and recent volatility in economics are shaping the way organizations create value and interact with each other. The future of many traditional hardware businesses lies in software. Our mission is to help manufacturing businesses turn change into a competitive advantage with comprehensive digital expertise that combines technology, data and human insight. Our industry customer portfolio consists of large enterprises and corporations from asset intensive process industries to world-class intelligent equipment OEMs.

As our business is constantly growing, we are now recruiting new team members to our Intelligent Devices team. This team delivers various software solutions for our clients in industrial domain by creating solutions for intelligent devices such as drones, forest machinery and other industrial solutions. Projects may vary from web software development projects to Industrial IoT and Edge Computing projects. You can choose your preferred work location from any of the following locations: Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere
or Turku
.

Your role as a Senior Software Developer

In this role, you will develop and maintain secure and scalable software solutions for our industrial customers. You will help translate customer needs into practical technical solutions and provide hands-on expertise throughout the project lifecycle—from early problem definition to implementation and continuous improvement.

As an experienced developer, you also take part in architectural decisions that ensure high-quality, reliable delivery at project level. You work closely with customers and teams, combining strong technical skills with a consultative approach to ensure solutions meet both business and technical goals. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5200-6200€.

What we expect from you

Several years of relevant experience in middleware software development using some of the following technologies: Java/Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Strong experience with public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Previous experience in software development projects related to IoT, or Edge Computing.
You are a trusted advisor to customers: capable of communicating complex technical concepts clearly, challenging assumptions constructively, and guiding stakeholders towards technology decisions that align with business objectives and create long-term value.
Familiarity with key industrial technologies and platforms such as Azure IoT Hub, AWS IoT Core, Kubernetes, KubeEdge, OPC UA, MQTT, and Crosser is highly beneficial.
Interest in the opportunities enabled by artificial intelligence, along with practical experience using AI either in a professional or personal context.

Your Role as a Software Architect

As a Software Architect, your responsibilities include the design and development of software solutions as well as providing technical leadership to project teams. You will work closely with both customers and project teams to develop solutions that address customer needs. You will support, challenge, and guide customers in focusing on the right problems, with the goal of delivering maximum business value.

In addition to project work, you will have the opportunity to influence future projects by supporting sales activities as a technical expert. This includes assisting with proposal preparation, participating in customer meetings, and performing requirements definition and architecture design activities. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5700-6700€.

In addition to the software development competencies above, we also expect you to:

Have experience working in a hands-on Software Architect role, with the ability to define and design the technical foundations and architecture of projects.
Act as a bridge between business and technology by translating customers’ business requirements into robust, sustainable technical solutions.
Have participated in pre-sales discussions with prospective and existing customers in the role of a technical expert, and be motivated to contribute as part of a team during proposal and tender processes.

Why join Solita?

This is an opportunity to work on demanding industrial software projects where modern software development meets real-world complexity. As Solita’s customer portfolio is versatile, you also have the opportunity to work in projects for other domains.
At Solita, we value expertise and give you room to make an impact. As a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect, you won’t just focus on implementation: you’ll also contribute to technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaboration with customers. Depending on your role and interests, you can deepen your hands-on technical work, take more architectural responsibility, and help shape the technologies and practices used in projects.
You’ll join a community of talented professionals who combine strong technical competence with a pragmatic, consultative way of working. We believe the best results are built together, through trust, knowledge sharing and a low-hierarchy culture where people genuinely support one another.

Sinulla on kokemusta turvaluokitellusta työskentelystä tai projektikokemusta Goforen ydinalueilta, kuten digitaalisesta yhteiskunnasta (julkinen sektori, vähittäiskauppa ja palvelut, terveys, turvallisuus) tai älykkäästä teollisuudesta (kone- ja laitevalmistus, tuotantoteollisuus)

Hyviä konsulttitaitoja ja kokemusta asiakasprojekteissa konsulttina toimimisesta eli asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi eri alojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa
Valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaan pyytäessä asiakkaan tiloissa osana kehitystiimiä

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Hyvinvoivat työntekijät ja sujuvan arjen luominen ovat Goforen ydin. Haluamme olla työyhteisö, jossa työn tekeminen on innostavaa, palkitsevaa ja ammatillista osaamista kasvattavaa. Maineemme laadukkaiden palveluiden tuottamisessa asiakkaillemme on yksinomaan huippuasiantuntijoidemme ansiota. Asiakastyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää ja NPS:mme onkin korkea, 62 (2025). Goforelaiset saavatkin erityisen hyvää palautetta asiakaslähtöisestä asenteesta. Työntekijätyytyväisyytemme perustuu tutkitusti osaavaan yhteisöön ja yhdessä tekemiseen.

Olemme ylpeitä läpinäkyvästä toimintakulttuuristamme, pioneerihenkisyydestämme sekä siitä että olemassaolollamme on suurempi tarkoitus kuin pelkästään voiton tuottaminen - pyrkimys inhimillisempään, kestävämpään ja eettisempään digimaailmaan ja työelämään. Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä jossa olet lähellä oman osaamisalueesi muita osaajia ja samalla läheisesti töitä tehden toisten huippuosaajien kanssa asiakasprojektissa. Olemme organisoituneet asiakaslähtöisesti, mikä mahdollistaa yksilö- ja tiimionnistumisten näkyväksi tekemisen ja oman osaamisen kasvattamisen vaikkapa toimiala edellä.

Goforelaisten yhteisöllisyys ulottuu myös työn ulkopuolelle erilaisten aktiviteettien kuten toimistotapahtumien, lautapelien ja perhepäivien muodossa. Jotta työ ja vapaa-aika löytäisivät tarvitsemasi tasapainon, tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelyolosuhteet ja työvälineet, jotka saat valita tarpeidesi mukaan.

Edellä mainittujen lisäksi meillä on kattavat etuudet. Goforella on käytössä oma, tekijöidemme näköinen työehtosopimus. Voit tutustua siihen täällä.

Palkkakehitys

Meille Goforella on tärkeää, että työstä maksetaan kunnollinen kokonaiskorvaus. Palkkaan vaikuttaa paitsi kokemus ja taidot, myös kaksi arvoamme: aktiiviset toimet sen eteen, että Gofore on hyvä työpaikka kaikille sekä asiakasnäkökulman huomioiminen kaikessa tekemisessä. Oman esihenkilön kanssa käytävissä palkkakeskusteluissa keskeistä on saamasi palaute, laskutusaste (olemmehan konsultteja!) sekä oman osaamisen kehittäminen.

Tyypillisesti palkkataso tässä roolissa asettuu välille 4500-6000 eur/kk. Kiinteän palkan lisäksi meillä on käytössä kuukausittaiseen laskutukseesi perustuvat bonukset. Määrittelemme sopivan palkkatason keskustelujen edetessä, kun tiedämme osaamisestasi tarkemmin.

jobs.description:
Liiketoiminta ja teknologia puhuvat usein eri kieltä, ja hyvä arkkitehti osaa molempia. Nyt etsimme kokeneita arkkitehteja kahdella näkökulmalla: liiketoimintalähtöisiä ratkaisuarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita ja tekniseen järjestelmäarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita asiantuntijoita.

Jos tunnistat itsesi jommastakummasta, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Senior Solution Architect:
Lähdet liikkeelle asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeista ja muutat tavoitteet toimiviksi, kustannustehokkaiksi ja toteutettaviksi kokonaisratkaisuiksi. Vertailet vaihtoehtoja, laadit tiekarttoja ja toimit siltana johdon, liiketoiminnan ja kehitystiimien välillä. Osaat perustella valintasi sekä kehitystiimille että johdolle. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen.

Senior Technical Architect:
Suunnittelet järjestelmiä, jotka kestävät kuormaa, muutoksia ja aikaa. Taustasi on ohjelmistokehityksessä, ja huomioit valinnoissasi skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja ylläpidettävyyden. Osaat myös tunnistaa teknisen velan ja modernisoida järjestelmiä hallitusti. Perustelet valintasi yhtä selkeästi kehitystiimille ja johdolle sekä jaat osaamistasi käytännönläheisesti. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen. 
Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

Millaista osaamista etsimme

Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ratkaisu-, kokonais- tai järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista tai ohjelmistokehityksestä
Kokemusta arkkitehtuurin suunnittelusta ja dokumentoinnista
Kokemusta liiketoimintatarpeiden ja vaatimusten muuttamisesta toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi
Ymmärrystä pilvipalveluista, integraatioista, data-arkkitehtuurista ja tietoturvasta
Kokemusta ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen ja teknologioiden arvioinnista ja vertailusta
Erinomaisia viestintä- ja sidosryhmätaitoja sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa
Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen julkisen sektorin hankinnoista, legacy-järjestelmien modernisointi- ja migraatioprojekteista, JHS 179 -menetelmän ja julkisen sektorin tietoturvavaatimusten (esim. Julkri) tuntemuksen sekä arkkitehtuuriin liittyvät sertifikaatit (esim. TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect Expert tai AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista menetelmistä ja teknologioista: TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN, C4-malli, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, REST, API Management, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja menetelmiä ja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus arkkitehtuurista, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi, kumpi rooli on sinulle luontevampi, ja kerro tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi

Asiakkaan liiketoimintatavoitteiden, tarpeiden ja vaatimusten kartoittaminen
Kokonaisratkaisujen ja teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Pilvi-, integraatio- ja data-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Teknologia- ja toimittajavalintojen arvioiminen ja perusteleminen
Tiekarttojen, arkkitehtuurikuvausten ja päätöksenteon tukimateriaalien laatiminen
Olemassa olevien järjestelmien arvioiminen ja modernisoinnin suunnitteleminen
Kehitystiimien ohjaaminen ja arkkitehtuurikatselmointien tekeminen
Yhteistyö asiakkaan johdon, liiketoiminnan, kehittäjien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

Prosessi ja palkkaus

Käymme kaikki hakemukset läpi ja vastaamme jokaiselle. Tutustumme sinuun CV:n tai LinkedIn-profiilisi kautta ja käymme myös nykyiset projektimme läpi. Mikäli projekteistamme saattaisi nyt tai lähitulevaisuudessa löytyä sinulle sopiva toimeksianto, kutsumme sinut tutustumistapaamiseen. Kun sinulle mahdollisesti sopiva asiakasprojekti löytyy, ja asiakas kiinnostuu osaamisestasi, haluaa hän useimmiten haastatella sinut kerran tai pari ennen lopullisen päätöksensä tekemistä. Mikäli asiakas haluaa sinut konsultikseen, pääsemme tekemään tarvittavat sopimukset: joko työsopimuksen tai alihankintasopimuksen, mikäli toimit mieluummin yrittäjänä.

Palkka määräytyy kokemuksen ja projektin perusteella välille 5000-8000+ €/kk. Halutessasi voit valita kiinteän tai laskutettuihin tunteihin perustuvan palkkamallin. Jos toimit alihankkijana, on tuntilaskutus useimmiten 60-100+ €/h.

Lisätietoa meistä

Marvel Consulting on noin 30 hengen asiantuntijatiimi, ja me kasvamme jatkuvasti! 🚀 Etsimme IT-alan osaajille mielenkiintoisia konsultointiprojekteja erilaisten asiakkaidemme parista. Työskentelemme pääosin vaativissa IT-projekteissa tukemalla asiakkaitamme heidän hankkeissaan, joihin liittyvät toimeksiannot kestävät usein kuukausia tai jopa vuosia. Asiakkaamme vaihtelevat pienyrityksistä startupeihin ja suuryrityksiin sekä julkisiin toimijoihin.

Tarjoamme asiantuntijoillemme:
Kilpailukykyisen palkan
Erittäin osaavat (ja mukavat!) kollegat
Mielenkiintoisia ja merkityksellisiä projekteja
Hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä laajan työterveyden

jobs.title: Associate Consultant – AI & Engineering
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are looking for students who are on their bachelors or masters that want to work on exciting projects, with fantastic colleagues and the newest technologies while providing value to our clients in the health industry.

Are you our new Associate Consultant within AI & Engineering?

We are looking for energetic, proactive, and curious Associates who want to be part of an exciting journey.

Associate Consultants at Intellishore play a vital role in our business. From the beginning, you will apply and develop your analytical, interpersonal, and development skills. You will work side by side with skilled consultants and contribute to a creative and contemporary company culture, where the skills and inputs of all employees are greatly valued.

You will get the chance to immerse yourself into some of the newest technologies whilst gaining an in-depth understanding of specific business challenges in the health industry, as you engage with clients in close collaboration with your dedicated Intellishore project team.

Our projects can be everything from actionable data and AI strategies, data architecture designs to advanced AI/ML models and scalable enterprise data platforms. Flexible and collaborative, we're not bound to any single technology or framework. You can read about some of our cases here: https://www.intellishore.dk/cases.

Our organization is structured around two tribes, Strategy & Transformation and AI & Engineering, working hand in hand on every project. We cross-staff dynamically, assembling cross-functional teams tailored to each project's needs. You'll be based in the AI & Engineering tribe.

Who is Intellishore?

Intellishore is founded in 2013, and is now home to 85+ passionate specialists in strategy, AI, and data, working from our Copenhagen and Zurich offices. We help and advise leading healthcare clients to shape the future of health, working with partners across the ecosystem to unlock the full potential of data and AI. Read more about our vision for Health 3.0 here: https://www.intellishore.dk/health.

We are builders who believe in an open and honest approach to consulting. We ask questions, stand by our beliefs, and cut through complexity to create clarity. For us, progress doesn’t come from technology alone - it happens when the right people have the right data, strategy, and tools to act. As a collective of developers and strategists, we bring energy, expertise, and a passion for helping our clients succeed.

Read more about our team here: https://www.intellishore.dk/about

What are we looking for in our new technical Associate?

We realize that you are still learning and need support, but you also need responsibilities that will push you further and develop your skills in the realm of digital transformation and healthcare.

As you will be supporting our experienced consultants on multiple cases no day is the same, but here is what you can expect and what we are looking for:

Natural flair for relation-building, stakeholder management, and communication
Work with either data science and data engineering and a wide range of technologies such as Python, Azure, GenAI, ML, LLMs etc.
Academic background in e.g. IT, engineering, or economics from CBS, ITU, DTU, KU
Part-time (Approximately 15-20 hours a week)
Preferably you have approx. two years remaining of your studies

As you develop skills and confidence, you will increase your responsibilities, and we will help you grow by tailoring a career model that urges you to apply the skills you already have and those you will gain at Intellishore.

Development is at the core of Intellishore, and we have dedicated plans for each Intellishorian and internal academy sessions for upskilling and knowledge sharing. You will also get the opportunity to influence and drive parts of the business development of Intellishore to ensure we keep getting better at delivering value to our clients.

What can we offer you?

1 | Challenging projects

Exciting and challenging consultant role in strategic and technical client projects

2 | Entrepreneurial work environment

A dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with ambitious colleagues

3 | Exciting industry

Unique opportunity to get a deep insight into the world of AI, Data & Analytics!

4 | Strategic seminars

Strategic seminars (previous years we've been to Germany, Italy, UK, Iceland and France)

5 | Flexibility

We offer a high level of flexibility in the position for you to balance your studies and work-life

6 | Amazing colleagues

Everyone talks about having a lot of social events but we don't need it, we just love spending time together!

Strategic Seminar

Every year all the Intellishorians leave behind their daily tasks to assemble for the annual Strategic Seminar to experience a change in scenery, strengthen their abilities to work together as a team, and gather inspiration to help set the overall direction of Intellishore and the work we do for our clients.

Just one more time. Why should I join Intellishore?

We are on an exciting journey to change the world of data and AI. We are entrepreneurial. We are a bit crazy. But we are also pretty cool. And nice. So, if you want to be part of an exciting journey with a bunch of crazy, but pretty cool and nice people, then don't hesitate to reach out. This is your opportunity to be part of something truly great.

Apply now

If you are interested in applying for this position, then send your application and motivational letter to us. Applicants will be invited to interviews on a rolling basis.

For more information about the position please reach out to Sofie Freund: sfr@intellishore.dk / +45 93 98 17 27

At the moment, we are only accepting applications from applicants inside of the EU who is located in Denmark.

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will be responsible for the end-to-end solutioning and development of software and web applications. You will be part of an agile team responsible for products used by the Financial Industry and MAS officers for Financial Supervision function.
Key Responsibilities

Backend Development:
1. Design, develop, and maintain microservices architecture using .NET Core, .NET 8 and Java.
2. Implement event-driven architecture to enable seamless communication between microservices.
3. Utilize Entity Framework (EF) for efficient database interactions and management.

GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.
