CCYC (Culture, Community and Youth Cluster) is a part of GovTech's Government Digital Transformation team where we support the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) and its statutory boards — such as the National Arts Council (NAC), People’s Association (PA), Sport Singapore (SportSG), and Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS)
— by delivering digital solutions that promote social cohesion, cultural vibrancy, and youth engagement.

[What you will be working on]

As a Software Engineer, You Will

Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure software applications across the full software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to define requirements, architect solutions, and deliver high-quality products.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in various programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#).
Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical systems.
Contribute to technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and best practices.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential application within GovTech's ecosystem.
Participate in agile development processes, including stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

You're not just here to write code, but also to figure out what we should be building and how we should build it. You will work on meaningful projects that solve problems pertinent to our society. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. Rather than work on commercial ventures commonly found in the startup scene, we're here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

Your job will be to bring expertise and capability to the public sector. Sometimes this means coding new systems from scratch. Other times this means using the best solutions the development community has to offer. We use cloud services, open-source software, and commodity hardware as far as possible. These often include, but are not limited to: GitHub, AWS, React Native, MongoDB, and Stripe amongst others. Knowing what to build and what to reuse lets us avoid wasting time on solved problems and focus on delivering actual value.

[What we are looking for]

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in software development with a strong track record of delivering successful projects
Experience in Mobile Application and Website Development, Content Management System (CMS)
Proficiency in at least two modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#) and experience with relevant frameworks.
Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Web development with Node.js background, preferably with Next.js and AI-assisted development
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Experience working on government or public sector projects is a plus.
A strong passion for public service and leveraging technology for the betterment of society.
Overall, we look for people who have ability, initiative, good communication, and strong values.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Please note that this will be a 2-year fixed term contract.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

The Professional Services Architect is accountable for the technical integrity, delivery viability, and customer outcomes of complex Dynatrace engagements. The role combines architecture, consulting, and implementation leadership to design scalable, supportable, and commercially viable solutions that help customers achieve their observability, automation, and digital transformation goals.

Working across customers, partners, and internal teams, the Architect defines solution strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance models, and operational standards while ensuring commitments are achievable before they are made. The role also strengthens delivery capability by mentoring consultants, promoting best practice, and contributing to the evolution of Dynatrace Professional Services methodologies and architectural standards.

Key Responsibilities

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and technical advisory engagements to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and success criteria.
Design and govern scalable Dynatrace solutions and deployment architectures across enterprise, cloud, and cloud-native environments, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and industry best practices.
Own the architectural quality and delivery readiness of assigned engagements, ensuring solutions are scalable, supportable, commercially viable, and aligned to measurable customer outcomes.
Define implementation strategies, onboarding approaches, governance models, operational standards, and transition plans that support long-term platform adoption and success.
Advise customers on observability strategies and the effective use of Dynatrace capabilities and ecosystem integrations to improve operational resilience, service performance, and business outcomes.
Architect and guide integrations between Dynatrace and enterprise platforms, including cloud services, ITSM solutions, security tools, CI/CD pipelines, and other operational systems.
Provide architectural leadership for RFP, RFI, and proposal engagements by defining solution strategies, validating requirements, and contributing to scope, estimates, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery risk—ensuring commitments are achievable before they are made to the customer.
Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders to address complex customer requirements, technical escalations, and product improvement opportunities.
Mentor consultants, partners, and technical teams by reviewing solution designs, sharing best practices, developing reusable assets, and driving delivery excellence across the organization.
Maintain expertise in modern observability, cloud-native technologies, automation, security, and operational best practices to provide trusted architectural guidance and thought leadership.

What Will Help You Succeed

Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in enterprise technology consulting, solution architecture, observability, platform engineering, SRE, cloud, application performance, or IT operations, including ownership of complex customer engagements.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale solutions across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Deep practical knowledge of modern application architectures, including microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, APIs, distributed systems, messaging, databases, and common enterprise middleware.
Strong understanding of telemetry and observability standards, including OpenTelemetry, OTLP, logs, metrics, traces, events, topology, service-level objectives, and data-quality practices.
Working knowledge of software delivery and operations practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SRE, incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, and DevSecOps.
Ability to create clear architecture diagrams, decision records, implementation plans, governance models, executive narratives, and technical documentation.
Ability to lead structured workshops, manage competing priorities, communicate risks, influence without authority, and present credibly from engineering teams to C-level executives.
Commercial and delivery acumen, including scope control, estimation, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and value-based outcome definition.
Relevant industry certifications across cloud, observability, automation, security, IT operations, or delivery are highly regarded, alongside demonstrated practical expertise.
Obtain Dynatrace Associate Certification within 2 months of joining and Dynatrace Professional Certification within 6 months of joining.
Commitment to continuous learning and maintaining relevant technical certifications.

Desired Experience

Architecture or transformation experience in regulated industries, government, financial services, telecommunications, or other complex enterprise environments.
Experience designing enterprise observability operating models, centers of excellence, platform-product models, or governance frameworks.
Experience with ServiceNow, major cloud platforms, Kubernetes platforms, OpenTelemetry, automation/orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security ecosystems.
Experience with executive value realization, adoption measurement, ROI narratives, quarterly business reviews, and outcome-based roadmaps.
Contributions to technical communities through reusable assets, enablement, white papers, conference sessions, blogs, or mentoring.

Travel And Development Requirements

Occasional customer-site, regional, or training travel may be required, subject to business need and local policy.
Continuous professional development is expected to maintain currency in the Dynatrace platform and relevant industry technologies.
The role may participate in field observation, strategic customer workshops, internal enablement, and industry events.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Validate end-to-end workflows across AI applications, APIs, and integrated systems.

Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

In this role, you will take operational ownership of complex ERP extensions—architecting robust AL codebases, integrating third-party systems via web services, and optimizing database performance across multi-tenant cloud environments.

You will treat ERP customization as a modern, disciplined software engineering practice. Rather than building intrusive base-code modifications, you will design clean, event-driven AL extensions using Visual Studio Code, establish automated release pipelines with AL Go and GitHub Actions, and ensure all features comply with Microsoft AppSource certification standards.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of dedicated software development experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central (and legacy Dynamics NAV), featuring expert-level proficiency in AL language, custom page/report extensions, codeunits, and event subscribers.
Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.
Extensive experience connecting Business Central with external systems, CRMs, and e-commerce platforms using RESTful web services, OData, JSON, and OAuth2 authentication.

Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.
Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse synchronization.
Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault).
Background in migrating legacy C/AL codebases (Dynamics NAV) to modern AL extensions.

jobs.title: Senior Architect (Agentic AI & Automations)
jobs.description:
The Agentic AI Automations Architect
is the senior technical authority for the design and delivery of conversational and agentic automations that resolve enterprise service requests across IT and Customer Service. Working on a modern Agentic AI Platform from our Partner, the Architect remains substantially hands-on, building and delivering to assigned customer accounts, while also owning the overall solution architecture, setting the patterns and standards the team builds to, and shaping solutions with customers from first conversation through to live production.

Key responsibilities:

Architect and build conversational and process automations
that collect from and act in external systems via platform connectors or direct API calls, covering knowledge retrieval, service request fulfilment, identity and access tasks, and guided troubleshooting, with safe handover to a live support experts.
Build agentic automations driven by prompts and function libraries
, defining the integrations, functions, and actions an automation can use so the generated prompt template selects the right function and populates its parameters from the request and connected data. The skill is in applying the LLM where it adds value while keeping flow logic explicit through designed nodes, branches, and decisions.
Own reference architectures, patterns, and standards for the Agentic AI platform
at expert level, translating each customer's context into the right design, judging which capabilities to apply for their environment, systems, constraints, and objectives, and curating proven, reusable patterns, flows, and components into a shared library the whole team designs and builds against.
Own the solution architecture for assigned accounts
, from solutioning through to live, supported production, engaging stakeholders directly to gather requirements, agree approach, and demonstrate value; owning design decisions and trade-offs and documenting them so the solution is defensible and maintainable; and overseeing build, deployment, and administration in the customer's environment, whether built personally or delivered with Engineers.
Map and integrate the customer's system landscape
, including systems of record (ITSM), identity directories, collaboration and productivity suites such as Microsoft 365, endpoint and digital-experience tooling, and CRM, ERP and HR systems, along with the data sources behind them, identifying the source of truth for each.
Work fluently across hosting topologies
, from public cloud (strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure) to private cloud, on-premises data centres, and hybrid combinations, and within the customer's network and connectivity boundaries.
Design identity and access integration
, connecting to the customer's identity provider for authentication, single sign-on, and federation with role-based, least-privilege access so automations act with auditable permissions and as the right user where needed.
Act as design authority
, deciding where each piece of logic and data should live, whether to use the platform, Azure, or a customer system for a given capability, and designing integrations resilient to the customer upgrading or replacing systems. Review the designs of Engineers, give clear technical direction, and keep solutions consistent with the team's reference architectures.
Raise the capability of the team
, mentoring Engineers, running design and code reviews, sharing reusable assets and good practice, and helping to evolve the way the CoE designs, builds, and delivers, all through influence rather than line management.
Use Microsoft Azure to complement and extend the platform
, filling gaps and fine-tuning where the platform alone is not sufficient. Apply Azure-native AI and agent services, in particular Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, its agent capabilities, model catalogue, and grounding and retrieval, both as an equivalent Agentic AI capability and a complement in Microsoft-heavy environments. Build supporting components (serverless functions, integration and workflow services, API gateways, event messaging) for orchestration, custom logic, and data preparation.
Evaluate capabilities and inform the technical roadmap
, assessing new Agentic AI and innovation features, Azure and Azure AI Foundry services, models, and emerging standards, running proofs of concept where useful; what to standardise on, and how the overall architecture should evolve.
Embed enterprise security throughout
, including zero-trust principles, secure handling of secrets and credentials, encryption in transit and at rest, PII masking, and content access controls per enterprise and regulatory requirements.
Test, deploy, and continuously improve
, with functional and reliability testing of real conversations and edge cases before production, promoting automations through development, test, and production environments under the customer's change process, and using analytics, unresolved-request review, and user feedback to increase automation and containment rates.

Required Skills and Experience:

Substantial hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI automations
or integrations on an enterprise conversational AI or agentic AI platform, or strong transferable experience in workflow automation and systems integration, with a track record of owning solution architecture, not only building to someone else's design. This includes designing agentic automations where a model selects and calls functions while the flow logic stays explicit and controlled.
Confident scripting for automation work
, in particular JavaScript, with strong JSON handling (parsing, building, and transforming payloads) and data mapping between systems using approaches such as JSON-path mapping and JOLT-style transformations.
Strong enterprise architecture experience
, with proven ability to design solutions across real customer environments: networks, servers, core enterprise services, and the mix of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid hosting most organisations run, Microsoft infrastructure prominent among them. Comfortable producing reference architectures and articulating design decisions and trade-offs to technical and senior audiences.
Experience integrating with enterprise business applications and systems of record
(ITSM and ticketing such as ServiceNow, CRM, ERP, HR, etc), including reading and writing to them and understanding their data models, permissions, and constraints.
Strong Microsoft Azure cloud expertise
: identity with Microsoft Entra ID, networking (virtual networks, network security groups, private endpoints, firewalls, hybrid connectivity), and core compute, integration, data, and AI services. This includes using Azure to complement and extend the Agentic AI platform capabilities.
Expertise
working with Azure AI Foundry to build or ground agents and use its model catalogue, particularly in Microsoft-heavy environments.
Strong integration skills across multiple mechanisms
: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and authorisation flows, including OAuth 2.0 in its common grant types, with token lifecycle and refresh handling, JSON, and event or message-driven patterns. Comfortable onboarding third-party APIs, with exposure to integration and middleware platforms.
Experience deploying and operating integration components across hybrid and on-premises environments, including Windows-hosted services or containers with secure outbound connectivity to SaaS.
Experience delivering conversational chat and voice channels into environments such as Microsoft Teams, embedded web chat.
Practical LLM skills for enterprise use, including prompt engineering and prompt management, selecting and configuring hosted models, RAG and grounding in trusted data, intent classification and entity or value extraction, knowledge ontology and synonym tuning, and evaluating model quality and reliability.
Experience shaping, scoping, and estimating engagements
, running discovery with customers, advising on feasibility and approach, and supporting sales and pre-sales with solution outlines, architectures, and effort estimates that can be costed and committed to.
Technical leadership and mentoring
, acting as design authority, running design and code reviews, setting standards, and raising the capability of engineers through influence rather than formal line management.
A high degree of autonomy and ownership
, able to own architecture across multiple customer accounts in parallel, act as the senior technical point of escalation, and take responsibility for solution quality and outcomes.

Desirable:

Prior experience in a solution architect, technical lead, or principal engineer role, ideally in a consultancy, managed-service, or multi-customer delivery setting.
Experience with one or more leading agentic AI or conversational automation platforms like UiPath or AutomationAnywhere, with adaptability to transfer skills to a new toolset.
Experience delivering in regulated or enterprise environments where governance, auditability, and access control matter, including Microsoft-heavy estates.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, in particular Azure Solutions Architect, alongside Azure administration, Azure AI, identity, and security, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
Emerging agent-interoperability standards such as the MCP, A2A, etc.

jobs.description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft Azure on behalf of our client to design, automate, and maintain high-availability cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will take operational ownership of enterprise Azure landing zones, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipeline automation—ensuring high reliability, cost efficiency, and zero-trust security compliance. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience managing enterprise Microsoft Azure environments, spanning compute, networking (VNets, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways), and storage tiers.
Advanced mastery of Terraform or Bicep for provision automation, drift detection, and maintaining state files across multi-subscription environments.
Proven track record building, securing, and scaling Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing ingress controllers, and deploying applications using Helm charts.
Deep proficiency in constructing automated build and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enforcing automated security scanning, policy compliance, and zero-downtime releases.
Solid understanding of cloud security governance using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, and implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) under a Zero Trust model.
Experience configuring end-to-end monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, or third-party platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace).
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-have:

Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Programming literacy in Python, Go, or PowerShell/Bash for infrastructure scripting and operator development.
Experience with cloud cost optimization frameworks (FinOps) and managing Azure Cost Management policies.
Exposure to hybrid cloud configurations or Azure Arc implementations.

Responsibilities:

Architect and deploy enterprise-grade Azure infrastructure using Terraform/Bicep, maintaining modular IaC libraries and strict state management workflows.
Provision, patch, and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing autoscaling, ingress routing, and service mesh policies.
Design, maintain, and secure automated CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions to accelerate developer deployment cycles.
Enforce Azure Policy guardrails, audit IAM roles via Entra ID, manage secret rotation in Key Vault, and mitigate vulnerabilities identified by Defender for Cloud.
Monitor system metrics, respond to infrastructure incidents, conduct root-cause analyses (RCA), and optimize cloud resource utilization to drive cost efficiencies.

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

jobs.description:

Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.

We are looking for:

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Work Package Manager to join our biometric solutions team.

What you will do:

From secure software to biometrics and encryption, Digital Identity & Security (DIS Global Business Unit) technologies and services enable businesses and governments to authenticate identities and protect data so they stay safe and enable services in personal devices, connected objects, the cloud and in between.

In the context of IBS, there are several projects ongoing to be delivered to our customers and we are looking for a Software Work Package Manager to contribute to the successful delivery of our projects, a key role in our organization.

You will collaborate closely with the Project Design Authority (PDA) and Integration Verification Validation and Qualification Manager (IVVQM).

You will identify, monitor and report the technical risks and related action plans.
You will be reporting to the Project Manager (PM) or Solution Engineering Manager (SEM) in schedule, progress, risks and workload.

You will be responsible for the work package requirements integrity and consistency throughout the project execution.
You will manage the sub-contractor and procurement technical assessment.
You collaborate with the customer on the technical aspects of the project execution.
You collaborate with the IVVQM to ensure verification and integration of the solution.
You will be structuring and mastering the delivery process, coordinating the teams, keeping right balance between time, costs and quality.

Technical background for at least 5 years (as software developer or quality engineer)
At least a first experience of 2 years in a technical management position
Facilitation skills to handle workshops with stakeholders to clarify requirements and scope
Knowledge of configuration and change management tools (e.g. JIRA)
Active contribution to communities (e.g. Project Management communities) and implement best practices
Experience in facing and mitigating risk, anticipating issues and creating opportunities.

What's in it for you:

Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit

We really welcome open-minded and committed people:

Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams

jobs.description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Business Central Developer on behalf of our client to lead the technical design, development, and customization of core Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions. In this role, you will take operational ownership of complex ERP extensions—architecting robust AL codebases, integrating third-party systems via web services, and optimizing database performance across multi-tenant cloud environments.

You will treat ERP customization as a modern, disciplined software engineering practice. Rather than building intrusive base-code modifications, you will design clean, event-driven AL extensions using Visual Studio Code, establish automated release pipelines with AL Go and GitHub Actions, and ensure all features comply with Microsoft AppSource certification standards.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of dedicated software development experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central (and legacy Dynamics NAV), featuring expert-level proficiency in AL language, custom page/report extensions, codeunits, and event subscribers.
Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.
Extensive experience connecting Business Central with external systems, CRMs, and e-commerce platforms using RESTful web services, OData, JSON, and OAuth2 authentication.
Daily practice authoring automated unit and integration tests using the AL Test Framework, utilizing test isolation and mocks to ensure upgrade stability.
Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-Have & Plus Skills

Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.
Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse synchronization.
Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault).
Background in migrating legacy C/AL codebases (Dynamics NAV) to modern AL extensions.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain scalable Business Central extensions in AL using event-driven architectures to customize ERP business logic cleanly.
Architect secure web service integrations between Business Central and external applications (ERPs, CRMs, banking networks, e-commerce storefronts).
Analyze system logs and telemetry using Business Central performance profilers and Application Insights to resolve locking, slow requests, and resource bottlenecks.
Establish and manage automated build, test, and release workflows using GitHub Actions and AL Go across development, staging, and production environments.
Enforce strict coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and ensure codebases strictly adhere to Microsoft's technical guidelines for cloud upgrades and AppSource publication.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft Azure on behalf of our client to design, automate, and maintain high-availability cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will take operational ownership of enterprise Azure landing zones, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipeline automation—ensuring high reliability, cost efficiency, and zero-trust security compliance. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience managing enterprise Microsoft Azure environments, spanning compute, networking (VNets, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways), and storage tiers.
Advanced mastery of Terraform or Bicep for provision automation, drift detection, and maintaining state files across multi-subscription environments.
Proven track record building, securing, and scaling Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing ingress controllers, and deploying applications using Helm charts.
Deep proficiency in constructing automated build and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enforcing automated security scanning, policy compliance, and zero-downtime releases.
Solid understanding of cloud security governance using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, and implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) under a Zero Trust model.
Experience configuring end-to-end monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, or third-party platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace).
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-have:

Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Programming literacy in Python, Go, or PowerShell/Bash for infrastructure scripting and operator development.
Experience with cloud cost optimization frameworks (FinOps) and managing Azure Cost Management policies.
Exposure to hybrid cloud configurations or Azure Arc implementations.

Responsibilities:

Architect and deploy enterprise-grade Azure infrastructure using Terraform/Bicep, maintaining modular IaC libraries and strict state management workflows.
Provision, patch, and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, managing autoscaling, ingress routing, and service mesh policies.
Design, maintain, and secure automated CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions to accelerate developer deployment cycles.
Enforce Azure Policy guardrails, audit IAM roles via Entra ID, manage secret rotation in Key Vault, and mitigate vulnerabilities identified by Defender for Cloud.
Monitor system metrics, respond to infrastructure incidents, conduct root-cause analyses (RCA), and optimize cloud resource utilization to drive cost efficiencies.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

Onze klant is een internationale groep in logistiek. Hun IT-afdeling bouwt en onderhoudt de applicaties waar de hele organisatie dagelijks op draait. Die software moet elke dag werken, dus er wordt bewust tijd gestoken in kwaliteit, architectuur en testen. Je komt in een team van developers en werkt nauw samen met de solution architect en de analisten.

Wat ga je doen als Full Stack Engineer?

Je bouwt full stack in C#/.NET, van SQL Server tot de front-end in Blazor, en denkt samen met de solution architect mee over nieuwe oplossingen.

Van analyse naar oplossing:
Je vertaalt functionele analyses naar een technische aanpak: componenten, services, interfaces en dataflows. Zie je een betere manier of klopt er iets niet, dan kaart je dat aan.
Bouwen met oog voor kwaliteit:
Je schrijft onderhoudbare code volgens clean architecture, doet code reviews en schrijft unit- en integratietesten. Releases worden gestructureerd gevalideerd.
Problemen bij de bron aanpakken:
Bij complexe bugs zoek je uit waar het misloopt, over applicatie, database en integraties heen. Je lost de oorzaak op, niet enkel het symptoom.
Agile/DevOps:
Je neemt deel aan refinements, schattingen en planning, en denkt mee over hoe het team beter kan werken.
Kennis delen:
Je helpt collega's verder, documenteert technische keuzes en brengt goede praktijken binnen het team.

Jouw skills en mindset

Minstens 3 jaar ervaring als C#/.NET-developer
Je denkt na over hoe iets gebouwd wordt, niet enkel of het werkt
Je legt een technische afweging helder uit, ook aan een analist
Pragmatisch en hands-on, met oog voor oplossingen die lang meegaan
Vlot Nederlands en Engels

Technische skills

Sterke kennis van C# en .NET 8 (of hoger)
ASP.NET Core
SQL Server
Git en Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines/CI/CD)
Unit testing met mocking frameworks
Ervaring met moderne webframeworks
Blazor 
Kennis van microservices en domain-driven design is een plus

Wat mag je verwachten?

Brutoloon:
tussen € 3.500 en € 4.500 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.
Voordelenpakket:

Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart of laadpas
Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
Jaarlijkse premie
Thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, gezinsleden kunnen aansluiten
Werkregime:
38-urenweek met 5 extra verlofdagen bovenop je wettelijk verlof

hybride werken en flexibele start- en einduren

Waarom deze job?

Je werkt aan software die echt gebruikt wordt binnen een internationale organisatie. De stack is modern, kwaliteit krijgt de nodige ruimte en je hebt als medior inspraak in het ontwerp. Een stevige basis om door te groeien naar een senior rol.

jobs.title: Senior .NET developer especializado en SQL Server, rendimiento y observabilidad
jobs.description:
El Puesto

Somos una empresa europea de software con un ERP de unos cuarenta módulos. Es un sistema con un uso intensivo de base de datos que gestiona procesos críticos con implicaciones legales.

• CAPA LEGACY: plataforma 4GL propietaria que sigue en producción. No trabajarás directamente sobre ella en este puesto.
• CAPA MODERNA: aplicación web construida con .NET 10 y Blazor Server, con SQL Server como base de datos. Aquí es donde trabajarás.

Buscamos un perfil .NET sénior a jornada completa para trabajar en nuestra aplicación web, con especial atención a SQL Server, la optimización y la observabilidad.

Es un puesto hands-on. Trabajarás junto al arquitecto responsable de la estrategia técnica, por lo que buscamos una persona sólida y resolutiva, aunque no tengas experiencia como arquitecto principal.

La aplicación web necesita mejorar su rendimiento, estabilidad y capacidad de diagnóstico. SQL Server interviene en muchos procesos de negocio y hay margen de mejora en las consultas, los patrones de acceso a datos, los índices, las transacciones, la concurrencia y la observabilidad.

Necesitamos a alguien capaz de investigar problemas reales de principio a fin, desde el código .NET hasta el plan de ejecución, e implementar soluciones medibles sin convertir cada cambio en un rediseño completo.

Responsabilidades

Analizar consultas lentas, planes de ejecución, índices, estadísticas, bloqueos, deadlocks, timeouts y consumo de recursos
Optimizar el acceso a datos desde .NET, incluidos la parametrización, la gestión de conexiones, las transacciones, la concurrencia y el tratamiento de errores
Mejorar la observabilidad de la aplicación y de SQL Server mediante logs estructurados, métricas, trazas, dashboards y alertas útiles
Investigar incidencias en producción y encontrar la causa raíz en el código, la base de datos o la interacción entre ambos
Implementar optimizaciones de forma segura, medir los resultados y evitar regresiones
Trabajar con el arquitecto y el resto del equipo para priorizar y ejecutar el roadmap técnico
Desarrollar y mantener funcionalidades de la aplicación web con C#, .NET 10 y Blazor Server

Resultados iniciales esperados

Conocimiento práctico de la aplicación web, sus workflows críticos y sus patrones de acceso a datos
Una línea base de rendimiento y observabilidad para los principales problemas de SQL Server
Primeras optimizaciones verificadas con métricas antes y después del cambio
Un backlog priorizado de mejoras en .NET, acceso a datos y SQL Server

Requisitos

Imprescindible
Experiencia profesional sólida con C# y .NET en aplicaciones web en producción
Experiencia avanzada con SQL Server, T-SQL, planes de ejecución, indexación, estadísticas y optimización de consultas
Capacidad para diagnosticar problemas de rendimiento, locking, blocking, deadlocks y concurrencia
Experiencia relacionando el comportamiento del código .NET con su impacto real en la base de datos
Criterio práctico para priorizar, implementar y validar mejoras en sistemas complejos

Se valora
Experiencia con Blazor Server y .NET 10
Experiencia con OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, Grafana, Datadog u otras herramientas de observabilidad
Experiencia con ERP, sistemas críticos o aplicaciones con un uso intensivo de base de datos
Conocimientos de CI/CD, testing de integración y análisis de regresiones de rendimiento

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Green Eagle Solutions is a leader in automating renewable energy operations, empowering energy producers to optimize their assets and trading strategies with innovative SaaS solutions. Our flagship platform, ARSOS, integrates advanced automation to enhance operational efficiency and trading performance, ensuring renewable energy producers can maximize revenue in dynamic energy markets. Join us in driving the energy transition and shaping the future of energy trading through cutting-edge automation.

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us. 🚀

If you are encouraged to do great things, join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

Green Eagle builds mission-critical energy optimisation systems. Our platform processes real-time telemetry from renewable assets and integrates with control centres and grid operators through industrial protocols. When it degrades, energy production is affected directly. Reliability and delivery speed are not preferences here; they are constraints we design for.
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform: the foundation that lets engineering teams ship safely, quickly and autonomously. You will design the systems, workflows and abstractions that reduce cognitive load and make reliability, security and scalability the default rather than something each team solves again on its own.
The Platform team operates as a product team, and internal engineers are your customers. Your first months will go into understanding the current infrastructure, the delivery pipelines and where teams work around the platform instead of through it. From there, your impact will come from adoption and from measurable outcomes for the teams you serve, not from the sophistication of what you build.

Our Environment:

We value proactivity and ownership, systems thinking, automation over manual work, and simple reusable solutions over unnecessary complexity. We expect engineering outcomes to be measured rather than asserted.
Our stack:
.NET services and Angular applications

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer .NET | C# | Azure
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer .NET | C# | Azure

About Us

We are a mobility provider based in Luxembourg, operating public transport, shuttles and on-demand services across the region. Our Digital Factory builds products that help the people behind these services work more effectively.
You will join the Foundry, our small software development team. We bring different areas of expertise, enjoy solving problems together and make time to help each other. We value the way people listen, learn and collaborate as much as the technical knowledge they bring.

About Our Digital Transformation

We are modernising the applications and systems that support our operations, with C#, .NET and Azure at the heart of our software environment and Microsoft Fabric supporting our data foundation.
You will contribute to a varied portfolio of digital products addressing operational and business challenges across the organisation. For example, we are building applications that help teams understand and improve workshop workflows, from welcoming a vehicle and organising maintenance to following work through to completion. We are also developing tools to analyse kilometres travelled without passengers, combining vehicle telemetry, reconciliation of planned and actual journeys, calculation logic and clear user interfaces to help teams investigate differences and identify potential savings.
These are two examples among a broader and evolving portfolio. Our products can combine operational workflows, user-facing applications, system integrations and live or frequently updated vehicle data. This can include location, energy consumption, vehicle condition and other telemetry generated by a connected fleet. The work offers opportunities to solve problems across several technical dimensions and different areas of the business.

About Your Role

You will design, build and improve digital products across the full stack, from user interfaces to backend services, APIs and application databases. Your work will include developing features used directly by operational teams, connecting existing systems and improving the reliability and usability of our applications.
You will also contribute to the shared technical foundations behind these products. This may include reusable services, integration patterns and common components that make future applications easier to build, connect and maintain. The role combines visible product development with deeper engineering work that can benefit several solutions across the organisation.
Understanding the business problem is part of the job. Working with Product Owners, Business Analysts and operational colleagues, you will explore how people work, clarify requirements and help shape practical solutions. You will consider how a change affects the wider workflow, its users and the systems around it, looking for the simplest approach that addresses the underlying need.
You will take ownership of agreed work through development, testing, deployment and production follow-up, with responsibilities suited to your experience. Our Tech Lead and colleagues will support you through code reviews, pairing and regular technical discussions.
You will have access to approved AI tools to support development, learning and exploration. We encourage you to think carefully about what can be delegated to AI, where human judgement is needed and how to verify the results. You remain responsible for understanding and testing what you deliver.

About You

You approach problems with curiosity and initiative. You want to understand why something is needed and are willing to investigate, ask questions and suggest options when requirements leave room for interpretation. You can move work forward independently while recognising when to seek guidance or validate an assumption.
You listen actively and take other people’s perspectives seriously. You bring humility to technical discussions, feel comfortable acknowledging what you do not know and can change your mind when new information reveals a better approach. You communicate progress and difficulties openly, and enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues.
You have hands-on experience building applications with C# and .NET. You are familiar with web interfaces, APIs, SQL and application databases, Git, testing and debugging, and care about building software that is secure, maintainable and reliable.
Hands-on Azure experience is required. Familiarity with a modern frontend framework, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices would be useful.
We welcome earlier-career candidates who meet the core C#, .NET and Azure requirements and demonstrate sound foundations, thoughtful problem-solving and a willingness to learn. You do not need to know every technology on day one. We want to understand how you think, work with others and develop your skills.
English is required. French and German are welcome advantages, but neither is required.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will have contributed useful and reliable features to our operational products and developed a strong understanding of the workflows they support. Your work will help users complete tasks more easily, understand operational issues and make better-informed decisions.
You will have contributed to both user-facing applications and the shared foundations behind them. You will identify gaps before they become problems, explain your technical choices and help the team find solutions that make sense across the wider system.
You will grow into greater technical ownership at a pace suited to your experience, contribute constructively to team discussions and build trust through dependable delivery, curiosity and collaboration.

Why Join Us

We take onboarding seriously. We will spend time introducing you to the business, the products and the people you will work with. You will learn how the team operates, who to speak with and where to find support, allowing you to build context and confidence as you take on greater responsibility.
You will join colleagues who make time to explain, discuss difficult problems and share feedback respectfully. There is room to contribute ideas, ask questions, experiment and learn from one another.
This is a permanent position where you can work on applications used in everyday transport operations, connected vehicle data and technical foundations that support several products. You will see how your work affects people’s time, the quality of their decisions and the reliability of the services they provide.
If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems across systems and building useful products with people who care about the outcome, we would be happy to meet you.
